status: Design only, deferred pending coherent2021 rounded-epoch baseline; never historical replay
purpose: Smallest conditional test of replacing an almost-known true peak by a peak estimated from the same noisy optical+NIR event
cadence_selection: Source SIMLIB11: lowest numeric LIBID containing bothJ andH, selected from metadata only. Retain source opticalgriz andJH epochs, backgrounds, zeropoints and flags; no invention of missing cadence.
generation: Native SNANA v11_04d with pinned B18/KCOR/SIMLIB and source photometric noise. Freeze a fresh seed and generated-attempt identity; retain fullprecision HEAD/PHOT and all rejected attempts. Nominal supported truthstretch1,AV0,RV1.518, source redshift/peak. Fixed truth deliberately isolates timing and does not represent the fitted parent population.

sample.engineering: 8 independent noise draws, not reused in later score
sample.conditional_mechanism_pilot: 64 independent draws at the one fixed cadence/truth after engineering gates
sample.pairing: Exactly identical latent event/noise/photometry across each fit branch

primary_branches: NIR distance with fixed true peak,shape1,AV0
Joint optical+NIR peak anddistance fit withshape1,AV0 fixed; insert its peak into NIR distance fit on identicalJHdata
noise_and_scatter: Begin with source photon/background noise and disabled intrinsic scatter as an explicit controlledmechanism arm; then a separatelydeclared OIR.J19 sensitivity on pairedlatent draws if first gate passes. Never infer a missing survey scatter correction by adding this result to existingOIR scatter.
peak_initialization: Same frozen measured/search-peak construction for every joint fit. Record source neartruth0.01dayheader separately; compare truefixedNIR baseline with estimatedpeak, not chosen offsets. A broader measured-initialization experiment is distinct.
mask_handling: Primary fixedcommon valid-phase JH mask; separatelyledger any normalnativephase-mask changes underestimatedpeak. Do not compare objectives acrossdifferentmasks aslikelihoodratios.
numerical_gates: Native noiseless recovery; exact sharedHEAD/PHOT identity; deterministic secondstarts; allfailures/bounds retained. Since shape/dust arefixed, a bounded one-dimensionalpeak profile plus validatedpositive-amplitudeprofile canindependentlycheckglobalnumericaloptimum underfrozencovariance. Any nativecovarianceupdate comparison is a separatealgorithmicgate, not assumedclosed.
estimand: Paired distance change and dispersion conditional on thiscadence/truth/noisemodel, with Monte Carlo standard errors, plus peak-error ledger. No physical-null p, realpopulationbias, or cosmologycorrection.
